format: New free-standing Buffalo Wild Wings Sports Bar (typically 3,500 to 6,500 sq ft), excluding land purchase, site work and demolition

invest.quote: Total Estimated Initial Investment (16)(17) $2,896,445 to $4,900,320 [New Free-Standing and Non-Traditional Location Sports Bars] $2,463,945 to $4,500,320 [Non-Free Standing and Conversion]. Cover: ranges from $2,463,945 to $4,900,320. This includes $12,500 to $156,200 that must be paid to the franchisor or an affiliate.

fee.quote: Traditional Sports Bar $25,000* Sports Bar at a Non-Traditional Location $12,500 ($1,250 multiplied by the number of full or partial years in the term, up to 10 years)
fee.note: Under a Development Agreement, $12,500 per bar development fee is credited toward the $25,000 fee. Training fee currently $2,500 per person (first three bars), $5,000 per person otherwise; opening team administrative fee $5,000 plus expenses estimated $20,000 to $100,000 (waived if you train your own staff). Fees may be reduced or waived case by case.

royalty.quote: Royalty Fee(3) 5% of Gross Sales(2), subject to applicable incentive program(3) Paid by electronic funds transfer every Friday for the preceding Reporting Period

adFund.quote: Advertising Fee(4) 4% of Gross Sales(2) and 2% of Gross Sales(2) for Non-Traditional Locations
adFund.note: 4% (may not increase more than 0.5% per year and will not exceed 4.15% in the initial term); plus local co-op/LMG contribution of at least 0.25% of Gross Sales (more if voted); $12,500 grand opening advertising spend.

otherRecurring.name: Loyalty Program Contribution Payments
otherRecurring.amount: Currently 2.2% of Loyalty Program Sales, weekly

otherRecurring.name: Learning management system fee
otherRecurring.amount: Currently $62.99 plus tax per Sports Bar per year

transferFee.amount: $12,500 (but see note 6); Family Transfers $1,000 plus costs and expenses not to exceed $12,500; multiple bars $12,500 for the first and $2,500 for each additional

headline.label: Average AUV (annual Gross Sales), franchised Buffalo Wild Wings Sports Bars open all of 2025

item19.note: Gross Sales only; no costs or profits. Excludes 15 franchised bars opened in 2025, 2 closed for extended periods, 4 that closed in 2025 and all company-owned bars. Includes 4 Non-Traditional Locations; bars average 15.1 years open and 4,000 to 10,000 sq ft.

special: Standard incentive (sign by March 31, 2027): Royalty Fee credit equal to $325,000 per new Sports Bar; Early Opening Incentive: 0% royalty up to 6 months for opening early; VetFran: $10,000 royalty credit per bar up to $100,000. For the second half of the term the royalty becomes the greater of 5% or the then-current rate (increase capped at 0.5%). Alcohol sales and liquor license ($5,000 to $500,000 in Item 7, up to $1,000,000 or more in some East Coast areas). Majority of units are company-owned.
issues: Cover range $2,463,945-$4,900,320 mixes the non-free-standing low and free-standing high; the free-standing Item 7 column ($2,896,445-$4,900,320) is used. Cover amount paid to franchisor ($12,500-$156,200) is not itemized in Item 7.
